name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
summary: Edit images by pointing: a magic wand changes only the region you select, segmentation picks precise areas, and background removal exports subjects with transparency. Takes up to five reference images at once. Live on grok.com/imagine and the mobile apps.

name: Kitesurf
summary: Run agent browsing on a cloud browser built for the job, not Chromium — about 3x less CPU and 5x less memory on screenshots, scraping, and form fills, though roughly 1.7x slower. Free in beta on Cloudflare Workers.

name: Hey Noah
summary: Text an executive assistant that books meetings, chases follow-ups, and emails your contacts directly instead of waiting for commands. Connects to Granola, Notion, Drive, and Slack. Free 30-day trial, no card.

name: Agent Plugins 1.0
summary: Package your agent skills and MCP servers into one folder — a plugin.json plus a skills/ dir — and load it in VS Code, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex, or Kiro. Write the extension once, run it everywhere.

name: Muse Code
summary: Run a terminal coding agent on macOS or Linux that spawns sub-agents and picks up where it left off after a crash. Pay-as-you-go at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens, or over 90% less if you opt into data sharing.

name: Notetaker
summary: Transcribe and summarize any meeting on your Mac without a bot joining the call — it listens to system audio. Pulls names from your calendar and connected apps so jargon and people's names come out spelled right. Free tier included.

name: FLUX 3 Video
summary: Generate 20-second 1080p clips with dialogue and sound effects from a text prompt or a still image, or continue a video you already have. Draft mode previews a shot at $0.06 per second, then re-renders it at full quality.

name: MiniMax H3
summary: Run a 42.5 GB open-weight video model on your own GPU. It takes text, image, video, and audio in one context and renders 15 seconds of 2K video with stereo sound. Weights on Hugging Face, native ComfyUI support.
